caption: The drawing depicts a marionette puppet suspended on visible strings against a plain, light beige background. The puppet features a dark brown, exaggerated head with large white eyes, a pronounced nose and lips, and short, textured black hair. It has a long-sleeved, white shirt that appears slightly wrinkled and extends to its wrists, where the dark brown hands are exposed. The puppet also wears fitted, light-colored pants and black shoes. Around its waist, there is a reddish-brown, tattered skirt or belt with multiple strips that hang down over the upper part of the pants. The figure's left arm is bent upward at the elbow with the hand upright and open, while the right arm hangs more naturally at the side. The strings attached to the head, arms, and legs emphasize that it is a marionette. The overall composition is centered, with no additional objects or background elements.
title: Joe, the Cannibal
